subject: Rheumatology
content: Rheumatology focuses on diseases affecting joints, bones, muscles, connective tissues, and immune-mediated systemic disorders.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: The musculoskeletal system includes bones, joints, muscles, tendons, ligaments, and other connective tissues that provide movement, support, and protection.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Autoimmune diseases occur when the immune system mistakenly attacks the body's own cells or tissues, potentially causing inflammation and organ damage.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Some rheumatic diseases produce inflammation that can affect multiple organs in addition to joints and other musculoskeletal tissues.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic autoimmune disease that primarily affects joints and can cause persistent inflammation, pain, stiffness, and progressive joint damage.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Rheumatoid arthritis commonly causes symmetrical inflammatory joint symptoms, particularly involving the hands, wrists, and feet.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Rheumatoid arthritis can affect organs outside the joints, including the lungs, heart, eyes, skin, and blood vessels.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis uses clinical findings together with laboratory tests and imaging; no single test establishes the diagnosis in every patient.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Treatment aims to control inflammation, prevent joint damage, preserve function, and improve quality of life using individualized medical management.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Osteoarthritis is a common joint disorder involving changes in cartilage and other joint tissues and commonly causes pain, stiffness, and reduced function.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Age, previous joint injury, excess body weight, joint stress, and certain genetic and structural factors can increase osteoarthritis risk.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Osteoarthritis commonly produces activity-related joint pain, stiffness after inactivity, and limitations in movement.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Management can include exercise, physical activity, weight management when appropriate, symptom-directed treatments, and surgery for selected severe disease.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Gout is an inflammatory arthritis caused by deposition of monosodium urate crystals in joints and other tissues.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: An acute gout attack can cause sudden severe joint pain, swelling, redness, and tenderness, often beginning in a single joint.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Hyperuricemia refers to elevated uric acid in the blood and can increase the likelihood of urate crystal formation, although not everyone with hyperuricemia develops gout.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Repeated gout attacks can lead to persistent inflammation and deposits of urate crystals called tophi, which may damage joints.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Risk factors for gout include genetic predisposition, kidney disease, certain medications, dietary factors, obesity, and other metabolic conditions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Systemic lupus erythematosus is a chronic autoimmune disease that can affect multiple organs, including skin, joints, kidneys, blood, lungs, and nervous system.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Lupus symptoms vary widely and may include fatigue, joint pain or swelling, skin rashes, fever, and organ-specific manifestations.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Lupus nephritis is kidney inflammation caused by systemic lupus and can impair kidney function if not recognized and managed appropriately.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Lupus diagnosis combines symptoms, examination findings, laboratory testing, and assessment for organ involvement because no single test is diagnostic in all cases.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Treatment is individualized according to disease manifestations and aims to reduce inflammation, prevent organ damage, and maintain function.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Spondyloarthritis is a group of inflammatory rheumatic diseases that commonly involve the spine, sacroiliac joints, peripheral joints, tendons, and entheses.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Ankylosing spondylitis is an inflammatory arthritis primarily affecting the spine and sacroiliac joints and can lead to chronic pain and stiffness.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory arthritis associated with psoriasis that can affect peripheral joints, the spine, entheses, and digits.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Reactive arthritis is inflammatory arthritis that can occur after certain infections and may involve joints, eyes, skin, or urinary or genital systems.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Juvenile idiopathic arthritis is a group of chronic inflammatory arthritides beginning during childhood and can affect joints and other body systems.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Vasculitis refers to inflammation of blood vessel walls and can affect vessels of different sizes and organs.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Giant cell arteritis is an inflammatory disease of large and medium arteries, commonly involving branches of the carotid artery and occurring mainly in older adults.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Polymyalgia rheumatica causes aching and stiffness, especially around the shoulders and hips, and commonly occurs in older adults.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: ANCA-associated vasculitides are systemic inflammatory disorders that can damage small blood vessels and may affect the kidneys, lungs, skin, and other organs.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Systemic sclerosis is an autoimmune connective tissue disease characterized by fibrosis and vascular abnormalities that can affect skin and internal organs.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Sjögren syndrome is an autoimmune disease that commonly affects moisture-producing glands, causing dry eyes and dry mouth, and may have systemic manifestations.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Dermatomyositis is an inflammatory muscle disease associated with characteristic skin findings and muscle weakness.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Polymyositis is an inflammatory muscle disorder characterized primarily by progressive muscle weakness.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Inflammatory myopathies commonly cause weakness of proximal muscles, affecting activities such as climbing stairs, rising from a chair, or lifting objects.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Fibromyalgia is a chronic pain disorder associated with widespread pain, fatigue, sleep disturbance, and cognitive symptoms.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Fibromyalgia is diagnosed clinically using the overall symptom pattern and examination rather than a single confirmatory laboratory test.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Osteoporosis is a skeletal disorder characterized by reduced bone strength and increased fracture risk.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Osteoporotic fractures commonly involve the hip, spine, and wrist and can lead to substantial disability and health complications.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Weight-bearing activity, muscle-strengthening exercise, adequate calcium and vitamin D, avoidance of tobacco, and appropriate fall prevention support bone health.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Bone mineral density testing is commonly used to assess bone density and fracture risk in appropriate patients.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Septic arthritis is infection within a joint and is an urgent condition because infection can rapidly damage cartilage and surrounding tissues.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Osteomyelitis is infection of bone that may arise through bloodstream spread, direct inoculation, or extension from nearby infected tissue.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Markers such as erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein can help assess systemic inflammation but are not specific for a particular rheumatic disease.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Rheumatoid factor is an antibody that may be present in rheumatoid arthritis and other conditions and therefore is not specific by itself.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibodies are useful laboratory markers in rheumatoid arthritis and can support diagnosis when interpreted with clinical findings.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Antinuclear antibodies are found in many autoimmune diseases and can support evaluation of connective tissue disease but are not diagnostic alone.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Analysis of synovial fluid can help distinguish inflammatory arthritis, infection, and crystal-associated arthritis.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Ultrasound can visualize joints, tendons, soft tissues, and inflammation and can support diagnosis and procedure guidance.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: MRI can demonstrate soft-tissue inflammation, bone marrow abnormalities, cartilage changes, and structural disease in selected musculoskeletal conditions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs can reduce pain and inflammation in several rheumatic conditions, but their risks and contraindications must be considered.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Glucocorticoids are potent anti-inflammatory medicines used in selected rheumatic diseases, with treatment decisions balancing benefits against potential adverse effects.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs are used to control inflammatory rheumatic disease and reduce disease activity and structural damage in appropriate conditions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Biologic medicines target specific immune or inflammatory pathways and are used for selected autoimmune and inflammatory rheumatic diseases.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Physical therapy and therapeutic exercise can improve mobility, strength, function, and symptom control across many musculoskeletal disorders.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Joint replacement surgery may be considered for severe joint disease when pain and functional impairment persist despite appropriate nonsurgical management.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Regular physical activity can help maintain muscle strength, joint function, mobility, and overall musculoskeletal health.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Fall prevention strategies are important for older adults and people with osteoporosis or musculoskeletal conditions because falls can cause serious fractures.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Rheumatology
content: Rheumatologic care integrates disease activity, organ involvement, function, comorbidities, medication risks, rehabilitation, and patient preferences.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.
